note: Flags for kit/hook_stop_wording_lint.py, as data. WARN-ONLY: the hook logs and never blocks. Promotion to blocking is a separate step that needs the measured false-positive rate (python3 kit/hook_stop_wording_lint.py report (platform/kit/ in a product repo)). Each flag answers a rule Tito set; cluster 'wording' in docs/architecture/complaint-audit-2026-10-24.json.

owner_for_tito.pattern: \b(the owner|the owner's|owner approval|owner needs|ask the owner|owner decides)\b(?! of\b)

command_for_tito.rule: Never hand Tito a gh or ssh command (credential separation).

utc_time.rule: Times in America/New_York with weekday and AM/PM; UTC stays in files.

tailscale.rule: Do not default to Tailscale; the LAN address works at home (decision 2026-10-23-private-pages-on-the-lan).

length.rule: Short chat; detail in structured files.
